Correlations Within and Between Feature Domains

Source: R/tbl_domain_correlations.R
tbl_domain_correlations.Rd

Lists pairs of features whose absolute correlation is at least `cutoff`, labelled by the domain of each feature (for example blood gas, pulmonary, cardiovascular) and by whether the pair lies within one domain or between two. See [tbl_correlated_pairs()] for a table without domains.

Usage

tbl_domain_correlations(
  data,
  domain_map,
  cutoff = 0.5,
  cross_domain_only = FALSE,
  method = c("pearson", "spearman")
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

domain_map

A data frame with columns `variable` (or `columns`) and `domain`, or a named vector (names = columns, values = domains). Only mapped numeric columns of `data` are used; a mapped column that is not in `data` is an error.

cutoff

Absolute correlation threshold in (0, 1]; a pair at exactly the cutoff is listed.

cross_domain_only

Keep only pairs from different domains.

method

`"pearson"` or `"spearman"` (pairwise complete observations).

Value

A tibble with `feature_1`, `domain_1`, `feature_2`, `domain_2`, `scope` (`"within"` or `"between"`), `correlation` and `n` (pairs of observations used), sorted by decreasing absolute correlation. Pairs whose correlation cannot be computed are not listed. The attribute `domain_summary` counts the listed pairs per domain pair.

See also

[tbl_correlated_pairs()], [corr_test_all()]

Examples

map <- c(mpg = "engine", disp = "engine", hp = "engine", wt = "body", qsec = "body", drat = "body")
tbl_domain_correlations(mtcars, map, cutoff = 0.7)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 7
#>   feature_1 domain_1 feature_2 domain_2 scope   correlation     n
#>   <chr>     <chr>    <chr>     <chr>    <chr>         <dbl> <int>
#> 1 disp      engine   wt        body     between       0.888    32
#> 2 mpg       engine   wt        body     between      -0.868    32
#> 3 mpg       engine   disp      engine   within       -0.848    32
#> 4 disp      engine   hp        engine   within        0.791    32
#> 5 mpg       engine   hp        engine   within       -0.776    32
#> 6 wt        body     drat      body     within       -0.712    32
#> 7 disp      engine   drat      body     between      -0.710    32
#> 8 hp        engine   qsec      body     between      -0.708    32
tbl_domain_correlations(mtcars, map, cutoff = 0.7, cross_domain_only = TRUE)
#> # A tibble: 4 × 7
#>   feature_1 domain_1 feature_2 domain_2 scope   correlation     n
#>   <chr>     <chr>    <chr>     <chr>    <chr>         <dbl> <int>
#> 1 disp      engine   wt        body     between       0.888    32
#> 2 mpg       engine   wt        body     between      -0.868    32
#> 3 disp      engine   drat      body     between      -0.710    32
#> 4 hp        engine   qsec      body     between      -0.708    32
